purpose: Prepare observation of the restored installed executable; this file is not consumed by the mod
before_launch: User resolves and verifies the antivirus detection
Run audit_camera.py against the restored INSTALLED EXE, not the staged depot file
Record SHA-256, file size, machine, timestamp, preferred image base, image size and every instruction-site result
Unknown SHA or any changed instruction bytes blocks all native-address experiments
Back up DLL and INI and verify their hashes; preserve the accepted SubmitMode=4 baseline

preserve: GPU projection and OpenXR FOV calibration
capture: Same engine-frame/Present ID for both eyes
Recorded projection Px/Py, replay eye scales/crop, submitted FOV and draw/primitive counts
Native receiver and lifetime, FOV and units, projection and CPU planes only after producer identity is proved

blocked_on: Prove active player-camera projection producer; a perspective helper alone is insufficient
Prove CPU visibility-frustum producer and its consumer
Prove common-frame propagation, receiver hierarchy and FOV axis/units
Validate exact executable identity and original instruction bytes before any hook
Compute residual GPU widening from the measured new projection to prevent double scaling
widening_experiment.physical_test: One stationary PSVR2 baseline/wide comparison only after the above gates pass
widening_experiment.rollback: On any stereo, lighting, loading, menu or Present regression, restore backed-up DLL and INI and verify hashes
